outlets.name: Leaf KYOTO (Leaf Publications)
outlets.credible: Kyoto's long-running local city/food magazine (Leaf Publications, since 1997) — local editorial of record for Kyoto restaurants and cafés.

outlets.name: OnTrip JAL (Japan Airlines)
outlets.credible: Japan Airlines' editorial travel magazine — a national carrier's travel content (cf. ANATRAVEL); one corroborating source.

outlets.name: Kansai International Airport — Explore Kansai
outlets.credible: Official regional guide published by Kansai Airports (KIX operator); one corroborating source.

outlets.name: MATCHA — Japan Travel Guide
outlets.credible: Major multilingual Japan travel media (MATCHA Inc., partnered with municipalities); one corroborating source.

outlets.name: SAVOR JAPAN
outlets.credible: Gurunavi's English editorial food guide; listed as credible in the Japan brief; one source.

outlets.name: MAPPLE (Shobunsha)
outlets.credible: Shobunsha's guidebook brand (Mapple/Mapple Magazine), Japan's leading travel-guide publisher; one source.

outlets.name: Inside Kyoto (Chris Rowthorn)
outlets.credible: Kyoto guide by Chris Rowthorn, long-time Kyoto resident and author of Lonely Planet's Kyoto/Japan guides; one corroborating source (creator/expert).

outlets.name: Official Nara Travel Guide (visitnara.jp)
outlets.credible: Nara Prefecture's official tourism guide — official tourism board; one source.

outlets.name: Fodor's Travel
outlets.credible: Long-established travel guidebook publisher; one source.

outlets.name: Anime News Network
outlets.credible: The English-language anime industry's news outlet of record (since 1998); one source for anime/pop-culture places.
